verdict.rationale: Zep documents an official Memory MCP Server that lets an end user connect MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others) to their own agent memory, with ABAC policies governing what Memory MCP users can reach. The open-source Graphiti MCP server offers an experimental self-hosted alternative for Claude, Cursor and VS Code. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that memory written by one client is actually recalled in another; clarity on whether sign-in via Google Workspace or an enterprise identity provider limits individual, non-enterprise users.
